stories.title: Trial Phase Scoring Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define the scoring schema mapping clinical trial phases (I–IV) to normalized quality scores, including handling for unknown or missing phase values. Establish contract for score output structure used by downstream services.

stories.title: Core Trial Phase Scoring Logic
stories.description: Implement backend logic to assign quality scores based on trial phase (Phase I–IV), ensuring deterministic scoring, clear ordering (IV highest), and safe handling of edge cases such as null or non-standard phase inputs.

stories.title: Integration with Clinical Trials Service Pipeline
stories.description: Integrate phase-based scoring into the clinical trials retrieval pipeline so each trial returned includes a computed quality score field aligned with the scoring contract.

stories.title: Expose Trial Phase Quality via Facade/API
stories.description: Ensure trial phase quality scores are exposed through the Evaluate Care facade and included in API/tool responses consumed by the chat layer.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Phase Scoring
stories.description: Create tests validating correct score assignment for each trial phase, edge cases (missing/invalid phase), and presence of scores in end-to-end clinical trial responses.
